name: GAN V100 3x3 (Magnetic, MagLev, Core Magnets, UV Coated) - Minions Edition
description: The GAN V100 3x3 (Magnetic, MagLev, Core Magnets, UV Coated) - Minions Edition brings a fully licensed Illumination's Minions makeover to GAN's flagship V100 platform: a custom 6-color exterior, a banana-yellow interior, and a Stuart center cap, wrapped around a dual-maglev speed cube built to turn as fast as it looks.
features: Fast right out of the tin: A dual-maglev magnetic system with 76 magnets does the alignment work for you, so turns settle into place instead of catching.
Dial it to your hands: 6 center-travel settings times 12 tension levels give 72 distinct handfeels, so one cube covers a lot of preferences.
Complete themed kit: Ships with a special GAN BOX, Minions packaging, a DIY sticker sheet, a themed cube bag, a tuning tool, and the manual.
72-gear numerical tuning: 6 center-travel settings combine with 12 tension levels for 72 custom handfeels, all set with the numbered dial.
Auto-aligning maglev: The dual-maglev system corrects up to 35 degrees, pulling near-misses into a clean layer.
Tool-assisted adjustment: The included custom tuning tool makes tension and travel changes repeatable, not guesswork.
